acceptance: Cutover PR merged with all required checks green and the visual change approved on the exact head
Production receipt shows Astro artifacts on trunk routes; probes green
Production rollback drill and roll-forward evidence recorded
Inventory diff against production: zero missing paths; atom.xml ids unchanged
Release-pinned /docs/ switches automatically at the next release that contains website/ (verified at that release)
description:
Go only if all of these hold:
- the G2 parity sign-off is current, re-run on the cutover base SHA
- the visual approval runbook is ready
- site-deploy has a successful Astro preview with a rollback drill on record
- the owner approves in writing

One PR to develop, alone at the queue front:
1. Commit the converted content as the new canonical source under website/src/content. Make docs/ read-only by deleting the Sphinx sources, or keep them only if the ADR says so.
2. Swap the docs unit in ci.yml from docs-build to site-build. Required-CI wiring and the drift guard change in the same PR.
3. Point visual capture at the Astro build and accept the one intentional baseline change through the exact-head approval path.
4. Switch the trunk routes in routes.yml to Astro.

After merge: deploy through site-deploy, probe every route, record the receipt, run one production rollback drill to the last Sphinx artifact and forward again.

Rollback trigger: any probe failure, a feed id change, or a missing inventory path. Response: redeploy the prior artifact by receipt and revert the PR.
